units.source_text: 学校开学前一天，即夏季最后一天的下午，住持应邀领着刚执事到一个地方做法事去了。

en.t: On the afternoon before school began, the last day of summer, the abbot had been invited to perform a memorial service somewhere and had gone off with the newly appointed steward.
Tsurukawa invited me to go see a movie.

units.source_text: 我不太感兴趣，他也突然兴致全无。

en.t: I was not very interested, and he too suddenly lost all enthusiasm.
That was just the kind of person Tsurukawa was.
